messages.text: Morning. FraudScore queue is noisy again. I've got a batch of wire_in alerts this week that look like false positives, scores in the 0.7s on pretty ordinary inbound wires. Anyone else seeing it?
Yes, a few came across my desk. Do you have an example? I want to see which features are driving the score before I touch any thresholds.

t_000194. $6,762.17 wire_in on 2026-07-03 into {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00356}} ({{CLIENT_NAME:c_0172}}), from Giles, Johnson and Adams. Scored 0.77. Counterparty is a known US business, and the sender account {{CP_ACCOUNT:cp_040}} has paid in before with no issues.
